source.note: Raw snapshot of the local variables and styles. Colours are 0-1 RGBA as Figma stores them. Each collection has one mode ("Mode 1").

variables.name: Font/Size/caption-xs
variables.description: 极小辅助信息、角标、金额小数、状态补充

variables.name: Font/Size/caption-sm
variables.description: 次级说明、时间、helper text、meta 信息

variables.name: Font/Size/label-md
variables.description: 表单 label、按钮文字、普通标签

variables.name: Font/Size/body-md
variables.description: 默认正文、列表正文、卡片内容

variables.name: Font/Size/body-lg
variables.description: 输入框文字、重要正文、关键字段

variables.name: Font/Size/title-md

variables.name: Font/Size/display-xl
variables.description: 活动页超大标题 / 主视觉数字
